etymologies.etymologyHTML: From depend +‎ -able.

definitions.definition: Able, or easily able to be depended on.

quote.citation: 2009 June 7, Jeff Z. Klein, “At Full Strength, Red Wings Dominate”, in New York Times‎[1]:
quote.text: But Datsyuk’s return rejuvenated the old dependables like Rafalski, Lidstrom and Marian Hossa, who consistently outshone Malkin and Crosby.
